ui.app_title: Return of the Obra Dinn Identity & Fate Hints & Check Programme

mobile.title: Please Use a Desktop Browser
mobile.text:
This programme is designed for desktop use — it relies on mouse hover and a large scrolling view.
It is nearly unusable on a phone, so please open this page in a desktop browser.

info.title: ABOUT
info.p1: This is the Identity & Fate Hints & Check programme for Return of the Obra Dinn.
info.p2: Thanks to Lucas Pope for creating this game. The magnifier cursor, portraits, HD character images and sound effects in this programme are from the game.
info.p3: This programme is free and open source on GitHub. You should never pay for it.
info.p4: The Simplified Chinese in-game terms and dialogues are based on {link}.
info.p5: This programme was made with the assistance of DeepSeek.
